scientific_scope: Reference-free engineering qualification of the already-frozen P4-v1 local-sector hard-detection Weber steering mechanism. This policy is frozen before P4 runtime implementation and before any P4 simulation execution.

nominal_reachability_panel.purpose: Verify finite deterministic detection-gated relative-sector steering, canonical biology-RNG isolation, structural invariances, both off/on gate states, and non-degenerate reference-free open-arena reachability without target outcomes.

required_structural_checks: For every exact-identity seed, zero-dose P4 is bit-exact to canonical ant state and biology RNG state with zero sector/gate/steering evaluations.
For every exact-identity seed, kappa=0 P4 is bit-exact to canonical ant state and biology RNG state with zero sector/gate/steering evaluations.

For every exact-identity seed at dose_ratio=0.10, P4 is bit-exact to canonical ant state and biology RNG state. The runtime may evaluate local signal, but every evaluation must remain subthreshold and add exactly zero heading increment.
P4 adds zero RNG streams and zero biology RNG draws.
The deterministic sensor operator produces exactly 32 front-left and 32 front-right samples using the frozen 4x8 equal-area midpoint rule.
The hard gate is exactly OFF at L+R == theta_detect and ON only for L+R > theta_detect.
Above threshold, the Weber directional response is left-right antisymmetric and conditionally positive-scale-invariant when scaling does not cross the threshold.
Scaling across theta_detect intentionally changes response expression between exactly OFF and Weber-directed ON.
Endpoint reversal, rigid translation, and rigid rotation preserve sector summaries, detection state, and steering within frozen tolerance.
Left-right reflection swaps sector summaries and reverses above-threshold steering sign with equal magnitude within frozen tolerance.
Centered parallel trail geometry away from endpoint effects yields equal sector summaries and zero steering within frozen tolerance.
Every nominal-panel trial completes without NaN/Infinity in ant state or P4 diagnostics.
At least one nominal-panel trial contains at least one above-threshold P4 steering evaluation.
At least one nominal-panel trial contains at least one subthreshold moving-step P4 evaluation so both gate states are exercised in open-arena execution.
Mean moving speed and all open-arena summaries are descriptive diagnostics only and may not tune the mechanism.
implementation_constraints: P4 runtime must extend canonical integrity.Simulation directly.
P4 may reuse frozen P1 helpers for apparatus, Gaussian field concentration, distance-to-segment, and moving-step preview only; it must not instantiate P1, P2, or P3 Simulation as a base.
P4 runtime may implement only the frozen local-sector hard-detection Weber steering mechanism.
No response RNG, signal-independent lapse state, stochastic detector, soft gate, sigmoid slope, Hill exponent, epsilon, or denominator regularizer is allowed.
No treatment-, path-, colony-, direction-, or experience-specific response parameter is allowed.
No speed, pause, angular-noise, contact, boundary, apparatus, observation, or scoring change is allowed.
No H2-H5 mechanism combination is allowed.
No canonical file may be modified.

result_rule.pass: All frozen structural checks pass on the exact panels. This establishes P4 implementation/reachability only, not biological fit.
result_rule.fail: Fix implementation defects only. Do not change the P4 mechanism, hard-gate boundary, sector geometry, engineering values, seeds, trial counts, dt, identities, invariances, or pass checks in response to reachability outcomes.
